title: Jump escape and primary outline: grounded carrier fixture correction
acceptance_criteria: Escape uses the root frame that produced its latest canonical body pin; carrier jumps retain five-second progress, while real relative displacement, damage, incapacity and stale custody still cancel.

A bounded neutral-input warm-up establishes real carrier grounding using the carrier epoch; a subsequent production jump creates the old mixed-frame delta above 0.3 while canonical coordinates remain stable and the same escape completes for the original mouse.
Ordinary clicks, gameplay-window clicks and outlines consume one primary target resolver, highlighting held medical item recipients generically and preserving item/block fallback and pickup priority.
Canonical pinning, strict release validation and containment lifecycle cleanup remain shared; r38 camera behavior and prototype capabilities are unchanged.

Fresh focused JVM, full native, UI/interaction/prediction readiness and isolated client startup pass before packaging; connected outline/input and optional observer landing presentation remain unverified.
manual_steps: Start escaping as a held playable mouse while the holder repeatedly jumps and moves. Five-second progress should complete, not restart; check backpack escape too.

Aim a held bruise pack, analyzer or syringe at a mouse and another supported body. Check that the white outline matches the clicked body; unrelated held items should retain their appropriate item/block recipient.
Recheck damage/incapacity/drop interruption and smooth held camera motion. Same-holder physical hand-transfer escape and continuous-jump observer landings are not claimed fixed.
